annotations.title: FUTA tax with state credit reduction calculator

description: Estimate annual FUTA tax, including the extra amount owed for wages paid in a credit reduction state such as California, and whether a deposit is required. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

caReduction.description: California 2026 credit reduction rate (your figure; DOL publishes the final list in November). Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. DOL lists only potential 2026 reductions until the final determination after Nov. 10, 2026. Enter the rate from the DOL final list (oui.doleta.gov/unemploy/futa_credit.asp) or Form 940 Schedule A.

credit.description: Maximum state unemployment credit. Enter as a percent number. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for maximum state unemployment credit. Unknown is not the same as zero. Official reference value 5.4% from IRS Topic no. 759, Form 940 FUTA tax, effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

futaBase.description: FUTA wage base per employee (US dollars). Only the first $7,000 paid to each employee in the calendar year is FUTA wages. Official reference value 7000 USD from IRS Topic no. 759, Form 940 FUTA tax, effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

futaRate.description: FUTA gross tax rate. Enter as a percent number. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for futa gross tax rate. Unknown is not the same as zero. Official reference value 6% from IRS Topic no. 759, Form 940 FUTA tax, effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

otherReduction.description: Other credit reduction state rate (your figure). Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Use for any other state or territory on the DOL final list, such as the U.S. Virgin Islands.

rows.description: Employees by state. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for employees by state. Unknown is not the same as zero.

label.description: Reference label (no names needed). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for reference label (no names needed). Unknown is not the same as zero. Optional reference label; no names or personal data.

state.description: State where the wages were paid. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for state where the wages were paid. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: none = State with no credit reduction; CA = California; other = Other credit reduction state.

wages.description: Wages paid in the year in this state (US dollars). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for wages paid in the year in this state. Unknown is not the same as zero.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

checkURL.description: Link that replays this calculation on https://buscalc.com/sumtru/verify/. Null when the inputs hold free-form text or the link would be too long.

notes.description: Reference-value notes first, then model notes and the standard limit statement.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.

sealURL.description: Where a saved record of this result can be sealed with an independent timestamp.
